description: The Fourth Amendment has no technology exception. South Dakota has no statute governing automated license plate readers. The networks are going up anyway, including a Flock system in Summerset that covers Stagebarn Middle School. A warrant to query, a deletion deadline in statute, no federal or out-of-state sharing without a South Dakota judge, and audits the public can actually read.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Zac Martin for South Dakota
title: Surveillance, Privacy, and the Fourth Amendment. Zac Martin for SD House 32
